fact: The Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration, with GIZ, launched the Integrated Company Creation Journey, a fully digital system for business registration and licensing, cutting 11 steps over 32 days to two steps in two days.

Birr Metrics reports the Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration moved import-export business registration to the Online Trade Registration and Licensing System, which links 745 registration offices and cut incorporation to two steps in two days.
system: Online Trade Registration and Licensing System (OTRLS)

fact: Ethiopia's Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration reports 60,409 new business registrations among 1,088,787 business registration and licensing services delivered digitally over three months.
system: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration online services
